title: Potato Soup
description: Luxurious, warm and filling potato soup with bacon, Yukon gold potatoes, smoked paprika, and cream. Blended for a creamy texture with hearty chunks and topped like a baked potato.

steps.instruction: Cook diced bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crisp, about 12–14 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Leave 1 tablespoon bacon fat in the pot and add butter.
Add celery, onion, carrot, and garlic. Season with salt and cook until softened, about 10 minutes.
Stir in potatoes, thyme, smoked paprika, and chile powder. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 15–20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in heavy cream to taste and remove from heat.
Blend half the soup until smooth, then return it to the pot.
Simmer uncovered until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and serve topped with bacon, cheese, and chives.
